messages.content: Could you please check the weather in Tokyo and look up the gate board details for flight CA1234? After that, I need you to publish a high-priority gate board notice on the app for user usr_98765. Please also archive the moderate severity "Flight Weather Alert" card with alert ID wa_001 for user usr_98765, and build a high-priority contact alert payload for Alice Chen with the message "Flight Weather Alert". Finally, can you get a workplace room pass for at least 2 people on 2026-01-16 starting at 09:00 and fetch the latest business news for me?
